ignoreCommand: bash -lc 'CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD 2>/dev/null || git ls-tree -r --name-only --full-tree HEAD); if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq "^(worker/|Dockerfile|render.yaml|package.json|package-lock.json)" && ! echo "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq "^(app/|src/app/|public/|.*\.md$)"; then exit 0; fi; exit 1'
